{
  "participants": [
    {
      "login": "sedited",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "objected to handling the race at the index level, preferring net_processing"
    },
    {
      "login": "ajtowns",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "objected to missing getcfheaders/getcfcheckpt; reviewed net_processing deferral with suggestions on timers and structs"
    },
    {
      "login": "mzumsande",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "supported addressing the race in net_processing but objected to modifying index internals when GetSummary suffices"
    }
  ],
  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "c:4763387253",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Handling peer race conditions inside BaseIndex couples indexing code to P2P transport concerns and risks stalls in other callers",
      "quote": "Reading through this, I don't think this should be handled on the index level.",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author moved the handling out of the index into net_processing",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:5106448059",
        "c:5186487219"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "c:5186487219",
      "status_by_quote": "Added deferring of a response, we store the racing request in a PendingCFilterRequest struct in a Peer and then check it"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3754782852",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "Remove the benchmarking commit instead of squashing it, and mark PR as draft while commits need replacing",
      "quote": "The benchmarking commit should be removed, not squashed, presumably? It doesn't seem like it'll be useful beyond developing this PR?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "benchmark commit removed",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:3785268150"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3785268150",
      "status_by_quote": "Removed benchmark commit."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3754789371",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "interface",
      "text": "Use std::list instead of std::optional for pending cfilter requests to handle multiple requests and save memory",
      "quote": "Rather than an optional, I'd suggest considering std::list<PendingCFilterREquest> and using push_back to add requests to the end",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "switched to std::list with a limit",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:3785270902"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3785270902",
      "status_by_quote": "Changed an optional in favor of a list with up to MAX_PENDING_CFILTER_REQUESTS=2 entries."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3759737064",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "interface",
      "text": "Touching index internals violates separation of concerns when GetSummary already exposes sufficient state",
      "quote": "Races in net_processing shouldn't be the business of indexes, and GetSummary() should have enough info... so I'd prefer if the index code was not touched at all",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author removed IsRacing and used GetSummary without touching index code",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:3785273391"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3785273391",
      "status_by_quote": "Removed IsRacing, now using GetSummary. No changes in GetSummary were required."
    },
    {
      "id": "c:5305915719",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "scope",
      "text": "Handle getcfheaders and getcfcheckpt the same as getcfilters since disconnects happen frequently for getcfheaders",
      "quote": "Based on the logs in #29655 this seems backwards -- there were more disconnects for getcfheaders than getcfilters? So I think this ought to be handled for all the cases?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "accepted",
      "status_note": "author implemented uniform handling across all three messages and ajtowns approved the revised approach",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:5331744681",
        "c:5427136075"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "r:5723891852",
      "status_by_quote": "Looks good to me, I think."
    },
    {
      "id": "c:5305915719",
      "part": 2,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Pause the peer entirely on a pending cfilter request instead of queueing cfilter responses and continuing to process other messages",
      "quote": "I wonder if it wouldn't be better to adopt the \"pause this peer\" approach, rather than queueing messages but continuing.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "accepted",
      "status_note": "author adopted the pausing approach and ajtowns approved the revised code",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:5331744681",
        "c:5427136075"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "r:5723891852",
      "status_by_quote": "Looks good to me, I think."
    },
    {
      "id": "r:5723891852",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "Update the PR description to match the revised approach",
      "quote": "PR description needs an update.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "open",
      "status_note": "",
      "author_replies": [],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "",
      "status_by_quote": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4432526080",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "Update the comment on CfilterIndexMayBeRacing (and consider renaming to ShouldDeferCFilterRequest) to reflect behavior during IBD",
      "quote": "You should update the comment on the declaration of `CfilterIndexMayBeRacing` to match this change in behaviour.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "renamed and updated comment",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4475625676"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4475625676",
      "status_by_quote": "Renamed and changed the comment."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4432539368",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "interface",
      "text": "Add req_time to PendingRequest struct to debug delays and abort requests that sit idle for an extended period",
      "quote": "so that we can more easily debug how long a request was delayed, and automatically abort/drop requests that sit idle for an extended period is probably a good idea.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "changed to struct with park_time and 5s timeout",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4475626397"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4475626397",
      "status_by_quote": "Changed to a struct... We (serve what we can and) drop a request which was parked for more than MAX_CF_PARK_INTERVAL=5s."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4432560943",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Consider adding a retry timer to only retry parked peers when ~100ms has elapsed to avoid blocking message processing if cs_main is held",
      "quote": "Could have two timers associated with the request so that as well as tracking when the peer was parked, we only do retries of parked peers when it's been 100ms or so since the last retry.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "added last_retry_time and 100ms retry interval",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4475640817"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4475640817",
      "status_by_quote": "Added `last_retry_time` and `PARKED_CF_RETRY_INTERVAL=100ms`, now we don't retry if the previous attempt was too recent."
    }
  ],
  "support": [
    {
      "id": "c:5127234440",
      "verdict": "",
      "reason": "Compact filter calculations are slow enough that races occur occasionally even for peers not on high-bandwidth compact block relay, so the issue is worth handling",
      "substantive": true,
      "evidence": "read",
      "areas": []
    },
    {
      "id": "c:5130725304",
      "verdict": "",
      "reason": "Agrees that handling racing compact filter requests in net_processing makes sense to prevent disconnects and avoid delaying getblocktxn responses",
      "substantive": true,
      "evidence": "read",
      "areas": []
    },
    {
      "id": "r:5723891852",
      "verdict": "",
      "reason": "Looks good to me, I think",
      "substantive": false,
      "evidence": "read",
      "areas": []
    }
  ],
  "notes": "Author replied to ajtowns' review suggestions from rc:4432526080, rc:4432539368, and rc:4432560943, pushing fixes for the method rename/comments, the PendingRequest struct with park_time and timeout, and the 100ms retry interval.",
  "waiting_on": [
    {
      "on": "reviewer",
      "what": "ajtowns to review author's pushed fixes for PendingRequest struct, retry throttling, and renaming",
      "id": "rc:4475640817"
    }
  ]
}
